Half of Nvidia's business, Huang said, is "really largely driven by open models." highlights: # Meta debuts Muse Spark 1.3 as personal agent work continues. Meta on Wednesday released Muse Spark 1.3, an update it says significantly improves performance in coding and agentic tasks. **Why it matters:** Meta is trying to keep pace with Anthropic, OpenAI and Google who all made major model announcements this week. * OpenAI, meanwhile, said Tuesday it will soon release its Astra model, though it will limit its most powerful cybersecurity capabilities to a smaller group of testers. **Zoom in:** Muse Spark 1.3 is priced the same as its predecessor, which Wang characterized as "aggressive.". **Between the lines:** With more powerful models, there is also more attention on safety, Wang said. * "We have more powerful models that are in development," he said. **What we're watching:** Whether Meta will continue to close the gap with Anthropic, OpenAI and Google and how its model improvements — especially in agentic work — show up in Meta's products.
